theorems.name: Submission.rsd_mw_exists_testForm_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsFiniteMeasure ν → IsOpen V → ν Vᶜ = 0 → Integrable β ν → (∀ᵐ x ∂ν, covectorEuclideanNorm (β x) ≤ 1) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, IsTestForm ω ∧ tsupport ω ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (ω x - β x)) ∂ν < ENNReal.ofReal ε
